claims: Granola listens to the call, then after it ends analyses the transcript and merges its notes with the notes you typed during the call
It organises by topic, so something mentioned late in the call is filed with the earlier discussion of that topic
Main benefit: your notes and the AI's notes are no longer scattered across two apps
how_to_steps: Open Granola alongside the meeting (Google Meet in Chrome) and type your own notes in it
End the call; Granola processes the transcript and merges it into your notes automatically
on_screen_only: Title overlay: 'This app mixes your meeting notes with the full call transcript'
